title: The Nativity: Third Joyful Mystery
summary: Pray the Third Joyful Mystery page by page: the story of the Nativity, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
coverAlt: Van Honthorst's painting of the Nativity: the newborn Jesus shines in the manger as Mary adores him.

pages.title: The Nativity
pages.body: In Bethlehem there was no room at the inn, so Jesus was born in a stable and laid in a manger. The King of heaven chose to come small and poor, close to shepherds and animals. As we pray this decade, we welcome Jesus into the simple corners of our own lives.
pages.alt: Van Honthorst's painting of the Nativity: the newborn Jesus shines in the manger as Mary adores him.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Gospel according to Luke, chapter 2 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And it came to pass, that when they were there, her days were accomplished, that she should be delivered. And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him up in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.”

(Luke 2:1-7)

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Nativity, the Third Joyful Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Detachment and holy poverty
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of detachment and holy poverty. God chose a stable. What simple thing in your life could become a place for Jesus?

Let us pray: Lord Jesus, make room in our hearts, as humble as your manger. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.
